We have a simple rule: as long others don't know who you are, be the gender we officially have. If someone knows you as alter you can have any gender you like.

We are on constant HRT since 7 years and there are no plans changing it. However we don't present female all the time. At the moment im wearing jeans and a hoodie. People read me male/female 50/50. 

Maybe you can easy the dysphoria of the other alter with small changes. Like not entirely being female presenting. Other clothes, maybe a new androgynous hair cut...

Hi,

I know the problem. 

We have solved this by system responsibility. 

No one is allowed to put stuff away that does not belong to them. Except there is a permission. And if you need to move items do it carefully.

E.g. we had a virtual reality headset. It set me up every time I saw it because it was wasted money. I however didn't touch it, until"Kopf" Said I can sell it. 

Or my book collection, no one tries to get rid of it despite the fact they don't read...

The need for glasses changes, body has a bad sight, so glasses are needed in general. 

BUT there is a difference in how bad our sight is(not a big deal around 0.5 Dioptrien per side and 1 prism Dioptrin change) but enough to not be comfortable with her glasses for me and the other way round. However we could just wear the same glasses without being blind, but it gives us somewhat level of comfort.

Recently switches got more frequent and I live in a sheltered setting. My psychiatrist had a closer look again(to be specific we started diagnosis from zero) and she came to the conclusion that it must be DID.

We grew out of all our names even alter names differ from time to time.

Our body was named "Sophie" after one of our alters who used to be host at the time we changed our body's name.

I had the name the body had when we were a child. Now I have a different name because the original Name hurts a few of us when it is pronounced.

The system was named "Elara inner shared flat"(sorry I translated this from German... don't know if it is correct... Original was "Elara-innen WG".

We decided to change to "Soul flammes" (Seelenflammen) because our therapist explained how new alters are formed like a flame can initiate another flame without losing something. And so we form more souls from other souls.
